Definition: Adonijah, the name of three Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Adonijah = "my lord is Jehovah"; 1) fourth son of David and Solomon's rival for the throne; 2) Levite sent by Jehoshaphat to teach the Law; 3) a chief of the people who co-operated with Nehemiah
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
